scientific_integrity: Elementary unconditional proof supplied; independent mathematical validation and audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for squarefree products of two distinct primes strictly greater than the fixed shift a>=2. Does not cover smaller prime factors or three-or-more-prime products. Finite checks corroborate, do not replace proof. Novelty comparison not exhaustive; Zheng paper inspected at abstract level only.
title: Sharp parity barriers for two-prime shifted Carmichael numbers
